text:
maria.cs: FYI - onboarding queue latency spike impacting a small set of priority accounts. Need customer-facing update + mitigation plan. Who can draft? (affects prod onboarding flows, signups paused for some tenants)
aj: I can draft. Quick ask: we should include affected tenant list, ETA for rollback, and an offer for a free onboarding enablement session + credit.
kate_product: Root cause preliminary: a recent config change to the onboarding write path increased index contention on our metadata DB. We rolled a partial rollback to canary, seeing reduced latency there. Full rollback in progress, ETA ~25-40m.
sean_ops: Canary rollback logs look good. I'll run a full rollback to the previous schema and monitor. Will post confirmation once token throughput returns to baseline.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-07-ONB-42 created for onboarding-latency by kate_product. Priority: P2.
jen_csm: Who are the affected accounts? we should surface renewal risk customers first and offer immediate 1:1 sessions. I can start outreach for 6 highest-risk accounts.
maria.cs: Affected list (internal) - sending to @aj and @jen_csm in DM now. Public comm should avoid technical detail, focus on impact, ETA, mitigation steps, and next steps for the customer.
aj: Draft message for customers: "Hi team — we're aware of delays affecting onboarding for some accounts. We're rolling back the change and expect normal onboarding to resume within ~30–45 minutes. As mitigation we can (1) offer priority processing for your pending onboards, (2) schedule a complimentary onboarding session with our CS engineer, and (3) apply a one-time credit for any SLA impact. We will follow up with a detailed RCA within 72 hours. Apologies for the disruption — we're on it." Thoughts? :pray:
kate_product: Text looks good. Add: "If you need immediate help, reply here or open a ticket with 'ONBOARD-PRIORITY' and we'll triage first."
sean_ops: After rollback completes I'll post a short technical note for CS to attach to the RCA: include timestamps, rollback commit id, and what telemetry shows about retry/resume behaviour.
jen_csm: OK. I'll tailor the customer message for the six renewal-risk accounts to mention an assigned CSM contact and propose 1:1. For the rest we'll send the generic update.
maria.cs: Great — @aj, please send the two variants (priority + general) to #customer-comm-drafts and paste final text here. @sean_ops, update when rollback confirmed so we can move to outbound.
aj: Will do. Posting drafts in ~10m.
sean_ops: Rollback completed at 2359991365. Metrics: onboarding queue latency back to baseline within 90s after rollback. Continuing to monitor for 30m.
maria.cs: Thanks. Once @aj posts drafts we'll start sending. Also capture any customer replies and forward to me so we can triage enablement requests and measure renewal risk.
jen_csm: Setting up a short feedback form and scheduling blocks for onboarding sessions. I'll share calendar links in the comms.
aj: Drafts posted to #customer-comm-drafts. Tagging QA: please sanity-check language for enterprise customers.
maria.cs: Closing loop: timeline for RCA publication: 72 hours. Action items assigned: @sean_ops - full telemetry export & rollback notes; @kate_product - root cause summary & long-term mitigation; @aj/@jen_csm - customer comms & targeted outreach.
sean_ops: Copy, starting telemetry export now.
jen_csm: Ready to start outreach as soon as drafts approved.
(END)
